description: Implementation of QpackBlockingManager class managing header block acknowledgements, stream cancellations, insert count increments, and blocking logic in QUIC QPACK.

classes.name: QpackBlockingManager
classes.description: Manages header block acknowledgements, stream cancellations, insert count increments, and stream blocking logic for QPACK in QUIC.

methods.name: OnHeaderAcknowledgement
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of header blocks for a given stream, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: OnStreamCancellation
methods.description: Handles cancellation of a stream, cleaning up associated header blocks.

methods.name: OnInsertCountIncrement
methods.description: Increments the known received count, ensuring no overflow occurs.

methods.name: OnHeaderBlockSent
methods.description: Records that a header block has been sent on a stream, increasing reference counts.

methods.name: blocking_allowed_on_stream
methods.description: Determines if blocking is allowed on a stream based on current header blocks and maximum blocked streams.

methods.name: smallest_blocking_index
methods.description: Returns the smallest index that is currently blocking.
